prompt_original: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: exclusive editorial illustration background for Baião Tech community event template, portrait 1080x1350 (4:5). Text and logos will be added separately; generate NO text, letters, logos, watermark or border. Warm sophisticated flat hand-painted paper illustration with subtle grain, expressive natural Brazilian people, terracotta #F9733B, sienna #8B3E2F, apricot #F6D7B7, restrained olive #6B7F56 on uniform ivory #FCFAF7. STRICT LAYOUT: entire upper 30% completely empty ivory. Entire left 56% empty ivory down to 70% height. All scene elements including people, props, scenery and shadows contained in rightmost 42%, between 35% and 84% height, with 3% right padding. Bottom 13% completely empty ivory for footer. The illustration is a compact detailed vertical vignette at lower right with softly tapering edges, no rectangle background. Full figures with coherent limbs/hands, no cropped faces. Recife startup ecosystem imagined as an open collaborative mangrove workspace: two young Brazilian entrepreneurs stand on a small raised wooden deck under a slender mangrove tree whose visible roots naturally interconnect beneath the platform. One holds a laptop, other holds a rolled sketch. A small innovative architectural model on a stool, subtle low river reflection. Ecological roots as collaboration metaphor, not a generic tech desk scene. CRITICAL ART DIRECTION: flat 2D editorial illustration like clean cut-paper screenprint: simplified stylized faces with tiny eyes, broad solid-color shapes, almost no shading, no detailed muscles, no realistic skin, no detailed fingers, NO photorealism or semi-realism, NO 3D volume, no painterly portrait rendering. Warm terracotta silhouettes and thin understated grain only. Landscape, if any, is grounded as a low irregular organic sweep at y1040–1140, never a floating island or rectangular platform and never a horizontal dividing line. People remain stylized and anatomically coherent. ALL upper 30% and left 56% down to y850 remain pure ivory; bottom y1190–1350 pure ivory.
motivo_rejeicao: Vinheta isolada sem continuidade lateral da paisagem e humanos excessivamente realistas em relação à referência; não aprovada para modelo final.
revisao_final: Empreendedores junto a mangue e maquete, com raízes em água e chão contínuo; sem plataforma flutuante. Sem cover_image: nome ocupa cabeçalho desde a margem, sem logo inventada. Traço flat editorial compatível com base genérica, sem realismo excessivo; paisagem contínua até ambas as bordas, transição em onda marfim sem linha horizontal e rodapé amplo livre. Cabeçalho, título, dados e assinatura legíveis, sem sobreposição; não há cenas/pessoas indevidamente duplicadas. PNG inspecionado individualmente e correspondente ao SVG pelo validador.
